findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed that the temperature-sensitive tape for the dish washer the facility uses is for 180 F, which means the water inside the dish washer is so hot that it is more steam than water when it hits the dishes. PIC states the facility normally uses a heavy wash cycle. Inspector measured the dish machine using a final temperature registering plate to be 151 F on the top rack, which is too low for sanitizing. Inspector used 160 F temperature-sensitive tape on the bottom rack which showed final temperatures of 160 F or above. PIC used 180 F temperature-sensitive tape on the bottom rack which showed final temperatures of 180 F or above. Inspector and PIC discussed using 160-170-180 F temperature-sensitive tape or a final temperature measuring plate to determine what is the optimal wash cycle and placement for dish sanitizing. Ensure that mechanical warewashing sanitizing water is between 160-170 F.

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: Observed that the prep sink and 3 handwashing sinks in the classroom had low hot water pressure. PICs were notified and they discussed repairs with the custodian. Ensure that water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed that the all gender single-use bathroom for adults did not have a lid on the trash can. CORRECTED: PIC was notified and ordered a lidded trash can that will arrive the next business day. Ensure that all bathrooms used by women have a covered trash receptacle in the stall.
